principle: Channel adapters implement platform-specific execution and evidence collection behind a stable Leverage interface.

interface.prepare: create an executable action payload without external side effects
interface.validate: check required fields, channel rules and approval state
interface.execute: perform an approved external action through the adapter
interface.verify: collect authoritative evidence of the action/result
interface.measure: map authoritative channel metrics into Leverage metrics

rules: No adapter may bypass platform rules.
No adapter may move money unless an explicitly authorized money-movement capability exists outside this interface.
External actions remain approval-gated according to action risk.
Unknown metrics remain unknown until authoritative evidence is returned.
Adapters must remain replaceable; core lifecycle logic must not depend on one provider.
